title: A listener belongs to the ValueTree object it was added to: a copy does not carry it, changes through a copy are heard, and destroying the object silences it

docs.says: Copying a ValueTree makes another reference to the same shared data.
A listener is attached to the particular ValueTree object it was added to, not to the shared data; when that object is destroyed its listeners go with it, even if other references to the data remain.

notes: Only one listener and one expected call, so the sequence is decided by the documentation.
